Site notes: the R&D subnet 10.1.5.0/24 is behind fw eth1; server 10.3.3.3 is behind fw eth4. The new app listens on 10.3.3.3 tcp/8443.
Plan: nft insert rule inet filter forward ip saddr 10.1.5.0/24 ip daddr 10.3.3.3 tcp dport 8443 accept
